texts.preamble: Keerthi Water Charitable Trust, ... vs The State Of Karnataka on 14 November, 2017 In The High Court Of Karna Taka Dharwad Bench Da Ted This The 14 t h Day Of November 2017 Before The Hon'Ble Mrs.Jus Tice K.S.Mudagal Writ Petition No.110768 Of 2017 [Gm-Res] Between: Keerthi Water Charitable Trust, Ballari Ward No.15, Building No.06, Hagari Vannurappa Complex, K.C. Road, (Durgappa Complex) Ballari. Represented By Its President Sri.K. Vannurappa S/O Pakkirappa, Age: 65 Years, Occ: Business, R/O: Ward No.15, Building No.06, Hagari Vannurappa Complex, K.C. Road, (Durgappa Complex) Ballari-583103. ... Petitioner (By Sri A .P. Murari, Advocate) And 1. The State Of Karnataka Represented By The Secretary To Government, Department Of Food & Civil Supplies, Vikas Soudha, Bengaluru.-560001. 2. The Designated Officer Department Of Food Safety And Standards, District Unit, Atp Road, Ballari-583103. 3. The Food Safety Officer :2: Department Of Food Safety And Standards, District Unit, Atp Road, Ballari-583103.
texts.facts: 3. The petitioner has established a drinking water unit in Ward No.15, Building No.16, Hagari Vannura ppa Complex, Ballari City, for public purpose. The 2 n d respondent issued notice Annexure 'D' to the petitioner on 04 t h October 2017 contending that the petitione r is running the said water unit for the purpose of consumption by the public without quality standard certification as required under Regulation No.2.3.14(17)(18) of Food Safety a nd Standards (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales) Regulations, 2011 and the petitioner has to show cause as to why the said Unit shall not be seized and action under Section 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 shall not be taken. 4. The petitioner has submitted his reply Annexure 'E' to the said show cause notice contending that it is serving only unpa cked drinking water on charita ble basis to cater to the needs of the poor people and for that, such certification or licence is not required. 6. It is contended that without disposing Annexure 'E', the objections and without hearing the petitioner in the matter, the petitioner's water serving unit is already seized by the 3 rd respondent. On issuing show cause notice, no further a ction should have been taken in the matter without considering the objections filed by the petitioner.
texts.arguments: 5. The petitioner contends that the Assistant Director of Public Health Services, Bengaluru a nd Assistant Director (Enforcement), Food Safety a nd Standards Authority of India have issued clarification that such certificate is not required. The said communication is at Annexure 'F'. The refore, the petitioner contends that it does not require certificate under the Food Safety a nd Standa rds Act, 2006.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 5. The petitioner contends that the Assistant Director of Public Health Services, Bengaluru a nd Assistant Director (Enforcement), Food Safety a nd Standards Authority of India have issued clarification that such certificate is not required. The said communication is at Annexure 'F'. The refore, the petitioner contends that it does not require certificate under the Food Safety a nd Standa rds Act, 2006.
